_meta.description: Stage 2 (Trained) for the universal Anaplan product Sales journey template. Mirrors the Delivery Stage 2 three-block structure (A: positioning context, B: application mastery, C: persona-specific motion) with sales-relevant content. Slots into the larger Sales template at stages[1].
structural_alignment_with_delivery: Same three-block structure: A (positioning context), B (application mastery), C (persona-specific motion)
Same self-serve digital scalable delivery model — no instructor-led tasks (no Sales workshop equivalent)
Same manager-info exit gate (manager contact required to exit Stage 2)
No comprehension check at Stage 2 exit — Stage 3 mock-pitch labs are the proof of mastery
Block A is persona-tailored to the Connected Planning narrative — sellers must position the individual application within the broader enterprise story per user direction
Block B replaces methodology-phases content (Delivery-only) with sales-relevant proof points: use cases, industry examples, client references
Block C replaces the methodology-phases webcast with a Selling Motion track: competitive, discovery, value-pitch playbook
_meta.boundary_with_stage_3: End of Stage 2: seller knows what the application does, who buys it, why, how to position it against competitors, how to qualify a customer, and how to construct a value pitch. They have NOT yet practiced delivering a pitch live. Stage 3 begins with mock pitches (AI-graded and senior-reviewer-graded). Verb shift: understand → practice.
open_items_parked_for_later: Per-product authoring spec — every Block A/B/C asset must be authored per product. Spec/template for each asset type to be defined as a separate work item.
Connected Planning context recording — single asset reused with per-topic framing; canonical version vs per-topic versions to be decided.
Sales-flavored Application Overview Academy course — does this exist for any product today, or must it be authored fresh? P7 inventory will answer.
Asset reuse with Pre-Sales — Use Cases, Industry Examples, Client References likely sharable across personas; Op Cmte / Single Content Policy decision.

_note: Stage 2 task structure is FIXED across all product journeys within the Sales persona. Asset content is VARIABLE per product.
name: Trained
description: Seller gains deep understanding of the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} application's value, positioning, use cases, client references, competitive landscape, and selling motion. No live customer interaction in this stage — that begins in Stage 4 (Stage 3 mock pitches sharpen the skill before Stage 4 client engagements).

blocks.name: Connected Planning Context
blocks.description: Brief framing of where the application fits within Anaplan's Connected Planning enterprise narrative.

blocks.name: Application Value Mastery
blocks.description: Cluster of complementary content — strategy, application overview, use cases, references — aimed at confidence in articulating the application's value.

blocks.name: Selling Motion
blocks.description: Competitive landscape, discovery and qualification approach, value pitch construction and objection handling.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} in the Connected Planning narrative
tasks.description: Short recording framing how {{PRODUCT_NAME}} fits into Anaplan's broader Connected Planning enterprise story. Sellers must be able to position the individual application AND elevate the conversation when multiple applications are in play (multi-application enterprise opportunities).

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} strategy & positioning (sales lens)
tasks.description: Webcast framing why the application exists, who it's for, the business outcomes it delivers, and how it's positioned in the market. Sales-lens emphasis on buyer personas, decision criteria, and the executive-level narrative.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Application Overview (Sales) Academy course
tasks.description: Self-paced Academy course providing a sales-relevant overview of the application — what it does, what dashboards and outputs the buyer sees, what business questions it answers. Lighter on configuration depth than the Delivery-persona Academy course; emphasis on buyer-visible value. Includes a short completion quiz.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} use cases & industry examples
tasks.description: Curated set of 5-7 use cases and industry exemplars showing how customers in different industries deploy {{PRODUCT_NAME}} and what business outcomes they achieve. Sellers absorb these as raw material for tailoring conversations to the prospect's industry.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} client reference stories
tasks.description: Library of named client reference stories with attributable outcomes, customer quotes, and reference-call protocol. Sellers learn the canonical references for {{PRODUCT_NAME}} and the rules of engagement for each.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} competitive battlecards walkthrough (sales lens)
tasks.description: Walkthrough of the competitive landscape for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}: top 3-5 competitors, where Anaplan wins and loses, key differentiators, and battlecard-by-battlecard talking points. Sales-lens emphasis on positioning and high-level differentiation; technical depth lives in the Pre-Sales journey.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} discovery & qualification guide
tasks.description: Discovery question library, qualification framework (e.g., MEDDPICC or partner equivalent applied to {{PRODUCT_NAME}}), and pattern guidance for moving a conversation from initial interest to a qualified opportunity.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} value pitch playbook & objection handling
tasks.description: Playbook for constructing a tailored value pitch — opening, value framing, proof points, ROI / business outcome anchors — combined with the top objections sellers encounter and their canonical responses. Together these prepare the seller for the Stage 3 mock-pitch lab.
tasks.asset: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Value Pitch Playbook & Objection Handling guide

_stage_actions_note: No system-side actions in Stage 2. Sales journeys do not provision sandboxes — Stage 3 mock-pitch lab requires only an AI-agent conversation interface and (for the live-reviewer mock) a scheduling slot.
_estimated_effort_total_note: Computed from task estimates. Comparable to Delivery Stage 2 (~3h 45min - 5h). Sellers' time is at a premium; every minute is purpose-built for selling-readiness.
